name: Dila
tagline: The Operating System for African Community Finance.
subhead: Modernizing rotating savings (Adashe/Esusu/Ajo) and cooperative thrifts through code-enforced, double-entry software.
description: Over 48.8 million Nigerian adults save in informal community groups. Dila replaces chaotic paper ledgers, fragmented WhatsApp messages, and cash tracking errors with a code-enforced double-entry ledger, deterministic payout scheduling, and printable QR cash collection bridges.
regulatory_disclaimer: Important Institutional Notice: Dila operates strictly as a pure software infrastructure platform. Dila does NOT take custody of funds, issue loans, or operate as a bank. All financial transactions route directly through Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN)-licensed commercial banks and regulated payment service providers.

key_features.title: Double-Entry Ledger Engine
key_features.description: Zero-dependency relational accounting engine enforcing mathematical debit/credit balance on local SQLite and cloud PostgreSQL.

key_features.title: Deterministic Payout Automation
key_features.description: Locks in rotation order algorithmically to eliminate timing disputes and favoritism.

key_features.title: Printable QR Collection Bridge
key_features.description: Generates high-contrast QR collection cards allowing cash and instant transfer reconciliation directly in local markets.

key_features.title: 152+ Screen UI System
key_features.description: Comprehensive design system across 20 modules covering onboarding, ledgers, payouts, receipts, CRM, and offline states.

target_audience: Group organizers, registered Multi-Purpose Cooperative Societies, market trade unions, and civil servant savings circles.

name: AMANA SHIELD
full_title: AMANA SHIELD — Civic Scam & Phishing Detection
tagline: Automated Scam and Phishing Detection for African Communities.
subhead: A multi-pillar intelligence engine protecting citizens from fraudulent government schemes, phishing links, and electoral impersonation via WhatsApp.
description: Developed for the AI4Elections 2026 civic initiative, AMANA SHIELD combines WhatsApp Cloud API intake with procedural RAG against official databases, DNS/RDAP domain risk verification, and structured indicator extraction to give citizens clear, non-technical advisories in English and Hausa.

key_features.title: Multi-Pillar Risk Fusion
key_features.description: Independently analyzes message text risk, destination URL risk, and claim status without arbitrary score collapse.

key_features.title: Grounded Uncertainty Abstention
key_features.description: Strictly abstains as UNVERIFIED when authoritative evidence is absent: lack of evidence is never treated as proof of falsity.

key_features.title: WhatsApp Cloud API Integration
key_features.description: Inbound webhook processing, cryptographic HMAC verification, sliding-window rate limiting, and structured advisory dispatch.

key_features.title: Bilingual Reporting (English & Hausa)
key_features.description: Translates complex cybersecurity threat indicators into plain, accessible language across Nigerian linguistic groups.

target_audience: Everyday citizens, civil society organizations, election observation missions, and fact-checking newsrooms.

name: ClassGPT-N Framework
subhead: Democratizing intelligent education for resource-constrained, Hausa-dominant African classrooms using local quantized models.
description: Bypasses the requirement for expensive broadband and cloud GPUs by running quantized Qwen 2.5B models locally on standard consumer hardware. Integrates N-ATLAS speech recognition for voice-first Hausa interactions and binds responses strictly to national Nigerian educational curricula.

key_features.title: Local Quantized LLM Inference
key_features.description: Runs 4-bit/8-bit quantized models locally on school-level edge hardware without requiring continuous internet access.

key_features.title: Curriculum-Grounded RAG
key_features.description: Pedagogical retrieval guardrails mapping AI explanations directly to approved Nigerian primary and secondary school syllabi.

key_features.title: Native Hausa Speech Recognition
key_features.description: Integrated N-ATLAS acoustic speech recognition models enabling voice-first verbal questioning for young and non-literate learners.

key_features.title: Pedagogical Mastery Tracking
key_features.description: Agent-agnostic state tracking providing step-by-step Socratic guidance rather than immediate answer dumping.

target_audience: Primary and secondary schools in low-connectivity regions, state universal basic education boards, and educational foundations.
